title: EXAMPLE - replace with your story (python film.py draft)
logline: An old woman roasting coffee at dawn remembers the proverb her mother taught her, and passes it to her grandson.
audience: PLACEHOLDER: diaspora cousins aged 18-35 watching on their phones, vertical, who know the coffee ceremony but not the proverb.
intent: PLACEHOLDER: they should feel the patience of the ceremony and want to call their grandmother.

style.block: Warm hand-painted gouache illustration, soft grain, golden-hour light, earthy ochre and indigo palette, gentle shadows, calm and intimate
style.negative: photorealistic, text, letters, watermark, extra fingers

characters.name: Grandmother
characters.description: a fictional Tigrayan woman in her seventies, slim, kind lined face, white netsela shawl with a thin green-and-gold border, silver cross pendant

characters.name: Grandson
characters.description: a fictional boy of about nine, short curly hair, faded blue t-shirt, bright curious eyes

narration.style_prompt: Read slowly and warmly, like an elder telling a story by the fire. Leave small pauses between sentences.

cues.caption: instrumental, gentle Ethiopian krar plucking with soft string pad, warm and nostalgic, sparse texture, no lead melody, slow build, theme returns at the end
cues.purpose: Underscore that leaves room for the voice, lifts at the hand-over, resolves on the end card.

shots.reason: Establishes the village and the hour before we meet anyone.
shots.image_prompt: A small stone house on a highland hillside at dawn, smoke rising from the roof, terraced fields and distant mountains

motion.prompt: smoke drifts slowly upward, camera holds still

narration.text: Every morning, before the village wakes, my grandmother lights the fire.
narration.english: Every morning, before the village wakes, my grandmother lights the fire.

shots.reason: Introduces the grandmother through what her hands do every day.
shots.image_prompt: The grandmother kneels by a small charcoal brazier inside the house, roasting green coffee beans in a flat iron pan

motion.prompt: she gently shakes the pan, smoke curls up, camera fixed

narration.text: She roasts the beans slowly. She never hurries them.
narration.english: She roasts the beans slowly. She never hurries them.

shots.reason: A close detail of the beans turning dark carries the idea of patience.
shots.image_prompt: Close view of coffee beans darkening in an iron pan over glowing coals, oily sheen, wisps of smoke

motion.prompt: beans shift slightly, smoke rises, slow push in

narration.text: The smoke fills the room, and the whole house smells of coffee.
narration.english: The smoke fills the room, and the whole house smells of coffee.

shots.reason: Brings in the grandson so the story has someone to pass to.
shots.image_prompt: The grandson sits on a low stool watching the grandmother pour water into a black clay jebena by the fire

motion.prompt: the boy leans forward slightly, firelight flickers, camera fixed

narration.text: When I was small, I asked her why it takes so long.
narration.english: When I was small, I asked her why it takes so long.

shots.reason: The grandmother's face as she speaks the proverb is the emotional centre.
shots.image_prompt: Close portrait of the grandmother smiling softly, firelight on her face, eyes looking at the boy just off-frame

motion.prompt: she blinks slowly and smiles, very slow push in

narration.text: She smiled and said: slowly, slowly, an egg will walk on its own legs.
narration.english: She smiled and said: "Slowly, slowly, an egg will walk on its own legs."

shots.reason: Gives the meaning of the proverb a picture of growth.
shots.image_prompt: A small chick stepping out of a cracked egg on straw in morning light near a doorway

motion.prompt: the chick takes one small step, camera holds

narration.text: Good things take their time. Patience turns small things into living things.
narration.english: Good things take their time. Patience turns small things into living things.

shots.reason: The cup passing between hands is the moment the tradition is handed down.
shots.image_prompt: Close view of the grandmother's hands passing a small white cup of coffee into the boy's small hands

motion.prompt: hands move slowly together, steam rises from the cup, camera fixed

narration.text: Now I live far away. But every morning, I make the coffee slowly.
narration.english: Now I live far away. But every morning, I make the coffee slowly.

shots.reason: Returns to the opening house in full daylight to close the circle.
shots.image_prompt: The same small stone house on the highland hillside in bright morning light, smoke rising from the roof, birds in the sky

motion.prompt: birds glide across the sky, camera pulls back slowly

narration.text: And I hear her voice: slowly, slowly.
narration.english: And I hear her voice: "Slowly, slowly."

lines: Made with AI: Gemini TTS, FLUX.2 klein, Wan 2.2, ACE-Step 1.5
Characters are fictional. Story told with my family's permission.
